# internal/woodstock/storage-conformance

Runner-independent conformance cases for one Woodstock Session storage host.

Adapted from Pi Durable's `src/testing/storage-conformance.ts`
(`earendil-works/pi` at 8efd314f): every host that backs Woodstock with a
[SqliteOwner](../../index.md#sqliteowner) — the local `node:sqlite` owner and
the Durable Object's `ctx.storage` — runs the same cases through Woodstock's own
writers and readers. Fungi delta: Pi's suite checks a generic record store (ID
minting, task and document tables); Woodstock's store is the parent-pointer
Session tree, so these cases check atomic admission, request-ID replay, bounded
lineage reads, branch, fork, placeholder completion, deletion and the inbox. The
cases import no test runner, only `node:assert`, so they run inside a Worker
with `nodejs_compat` too.

## Type Aliases

### WoodstockStorageProvider

```ts
type WoodstockStorageProvider = (use) => Promise<void>;
```

Calls `use` exactly once with an empty, writable owner of the host under test,
then releases the owner. It resolves after `use` returns.

#### Parameters

| --------- | ------------------- |
| `use`     | (`owner`) => `void` |
